Meet Your 3D Desktop Goobers

Fully rigged 3D anime chibi models roaming across the bottom of your screen. Pick them up, fling them, pet them with hearts, feed them snacks, or trigger high-speed stampedes!

🤏

Pick Up & Toss

Click & drag any chibi into the air to watch their legs kick frantically, then release with momentum to fling them across the screen!

❤️

Headpats & Petting

Hold your cursor and wiggle rapidly over a chibi's head to pet them. Watch floating hearts erupt and listen to contented purrs!

🥕

Feed Snacks

Click the carrot button or press Alt + C anywhere. Watch nearby chibis rush over for tasty treats and crunchy munch sounds!

🏁

Stampede Race

Hit the Stampede button to line up all your active chibis on the left for a high-octane sprint across the bottom of the screen!

Procedural 3D Rigging

Zero Stored Keyframes

150+ skeletal bones per character are dynamically driven by procedural physics, pendulum swings, squash-and-stretch landing impacts, and randomized emotional gestures.

Web Audio Synthesizer

Zero Audio Files Required

All sound effects (footstep taps, squeaks, springy boings, munching crumbs, purrs, and race whistles) are synthesized in real-time using the browser's Web Audio API.

Isolated Shadow DOM

Non-Intrusive Overlay

All canvases, speech bubbles, and particle effects reside inside an encapsulated Shadow DOM root to guarantee zero CSS bleeding or interference with host websites.
